patch.summary:
Choose LearnWorlds only if your buying job matches “AI-powered LMS for creating, selling, and delivering online courses and academies.” rather than Adobe Marketo Engage's shape. Choose Adobe Marketo Engage only if your buying job matches “Enterprise B2B marketing automation platform (Adobe Marketo Engage) — custom quote; CRM se” rather than LearnWorlds's shape. Workflow advantage: LearnWorlds leans creator-marketing, funnel-building; Adobe Marketo Engage leans marketing-automation, lead-nurturing. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: LearnWorlds is AI-powered LMS for creating, selling, and delivering online courses and academies.; Adobe Marketo Engage is Enterprise B2B marketing automation platform (Adobe Marketo Engage) — custom quote; CRM secondary..
- Company-size focus: LearnWorlds (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Adobe Marketo Engage (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: LearnWorlds-leaning creator-marketing, funnel-building, multichannel-campaigns vs Adobe Marketo Engage-leaning marketing-automation, lead-nurturing, analytics.
- Researched limits: LearnWorlds — Starter charges $5 per paid enrollment; Adobe Marketo Engage — Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency.

Limitations — LearnWorlds: Starter charges $5 per paid enrollment; Active learner and admin caps by plan; Adobe Marketo Engage: Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency; Implementation/ops overhead is enterprise-grade.
